### OpenRegister reliance

**none**: this component does not touch OpenRegister, directly or through anything it imports. 0 direct references, 0 files reached through imports.

See the [reliance overview](./index.md#openregister-reliance) for the filterable list.

### Props

| Name             | Type                  | Required | Default   | Description                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | -------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rows`           | `array`               |          | `[]`      | The rows: objects with an id (`rowIdKey`), a label (`rowLabelKey`) and an optional `readOnly`. With `pickPerRow` also `weight` and `options`: `{ key, label, description?, points? }`. |
| `columns`        | `array`               |          | `[]`      | The columns: `{ key, label, description?, readOnly?, points? }`.                                                                                                                       |
| `choices`        | `array`               |          | `[]`      | The closed set every cell picks from: `{ value, label, tone? }`, `tone` being `muted` or `strong`.                                                                                     |
| `modelValue`     | `object`              |          | `\{\}`    | The stored choices: `{ [rowId]: { [columnKey]: value } }`, or with `pickPerRow` `{ [rowId]: optionKey }`.                                                                              |
| `defaultValue`   | `string`              |          | `''`      | The choice value a cell shows while nothing is stored for it.                                                                                                                          |
| `rowIdKey`       | `string`              |          | `'id'`    | Key of a row's id.                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `rowLabelKey`    | `string`              |          | `'label'` | Key of a row's label.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `rowHeader`      | `string`              |          | `''`      | Heading of the row column, already translated.                                                                                                                                         |
| `title`          | `string`              |          | `''`      | Title above the grid, already translated.                                                                                                                                              |
| `description`    | `string`              |          | `''`      | A line under the title, already translated.                                                                                                                                            |
| `emptyLabel`     | `string`              |          | `''`      | Text when there are no rows or columns; the library default is "Nothing to set yet.".                                                                                                  |
| `readOnly`       | `boolean`             |          | `false`   | Draw every cell as text.                                                                                                                                                               |
| `pickPerRow`     | `boolean`             |          | `false`   | A row holds one pick, drawn as radio buttons, rather than a choice per column.                                                                                                         |
| `scoreLabel`     | `boolean&#124;string` |          | `false`   | Show the score: `true` for the library's words, or a text with `{score}` and `{max}`, already translated.                                                                              |
| `scoreMax`       | `number`              |          | `null`    | The most a user can score; the sum of each row's highest points when null.                                                                                                             |
| `scoreMode`      | `string`              |          | `'sum'`   | How picks add up: `sum` adds the points, `weighted` multiplies each by its row's `weight` first.                                                                                       |
| `weightTemplate` | `string`              |          | `''`      | A row's weight in words, already translated, with `{weight}`.                                                                                                                          |
| `rowErrors`      | `object`              |          | `\{\}`    | Errors per row, already translated: `{ [rowId]: text }`.                                                                                                                               |
| `removableRows`  | `boolean`             |          | `false`   | A Remove button per row; a row with `removable: false` keeps none. Ignored when `readOnly`.                                                                                            |
| `sortable`       | `boolean`             |          | `false`   | A sort button in every head of the grid: the row column by label, a column by the order of `choices`.                                                                                  |
| `filterable`     | `boolean`             |          | `false`   | A filter in every head of the grid: a text filter on the row column, a tick per value on a column.                                                                                     |
| `pills`          | `boolean`             |          | `false`   | Draw a read-only cell as a pill (`CnStatusBadge`) in its choice's `variant`, `default` when it names none.                                                                             |
